purpose: VJ-027 acceptance: an independent worked example. The expected values below were derived by applying the stated BPHS rule arithmetically, NOT by running the engine and recording what it produced. A fixture recorded from the code under test proves only that the code is deterministic.

input.note: The sidereal Moon of the chennai-1990-05-15 chart fixture (Lahiri), which the VJ-008 Electron proof also used.

derivation: BPHS Ch.46 lord cycle: Ketu, Venus, Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury
lord of nakshatra 20 = cycle[20 mod 9] = cycle[2] = Sun
Sun's full mahadasha = 6 years, so the balance at birth = 6 x (1 - 0.2381678620) = 4.570992828
mahadasha order runs from Sun: Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Ketu, Venus
each later mahadasha takes its full BPHS span; only the first is shortened

firstBhuktiOfSun.note: Sub-periods are pro-rated against the shortened parent, not the full 6 years: each sublord's share = parentDuration x sublordYears / 120.

tolerance.note: The derivation above is written to nine decimals; the engine works in full double precision, so agreement to 1e-6 years (about 30 seconds) is the bar.
